PlussTils

Cross-cutting utilities shared by every other space: filesystem pathing, the PlussView desktop viewer, and auxiliary helpers such as OutputEngine.

API Reference

What's in this space

PlussTils has no table or numeric object of its own -- it's the toolbox every other space reaches for.
